title: 5 Police Officers Killed, 5 Wounded in CJNG-Territory Ambush Near Nahuatzen, Michoacán — Eve of World Cup Opener
detail: Gunmen ambushed a Michoacán state police patrol near La Mojonera, on the road connecting Nahuatzen and Zacapu in the Meseta Purépecha region of Michoacán — CJNG operational territory contested with Los Viagras and Cárteles Unidos — killing 5 officers and wounding 5 others. The officers' pickup truck was left riddled with high-caliber bullet holes, per images obtained by AFP. The attack occurred Wednesday, June 10, 2026, the eve of the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match in Mexico City, underscoring that CJNG's tournament-window 'blackout directive' on high-visibility violence has applied selectively to internationally visible urban centers (Guadalajara, Mexico City, Monterrey) rather than to rural territorial enforcement in Michoacán's contested corridors. A former Michoacán police chief said 'the criminals responsible for this attack must be arrested and punished with the full weight of the law.' No arrests were reported in immediate aftermath coverage.

media.caption: Bullet-riddled police pickup truck near La Mojonera, Nahuatzen, Michoacán, after the June 10 ambush that killed 5 officers
